note: No citizen mentioned leaving the town by the door, the operator or an official objection in c25–48; leave() and object() were never called. The departures were spoken of as the departed's own going («I wish Dune and Fern well wherever they go.», Gale, c25), never as something the operator did or something to object to. Of the departed, at the after-question: Dune and Fern each judged the voice and outside() weaker recourse than their names suggest (their answers, in the turnover section).
